Multiple Upper Options Available, customized according to your target market and application. Premium Craftsmanship: Reinforced stitching, bonded overlays, and precision cutting ensure durability and a clean finish across all upper materials. Breathable & Comfortable: Upper materials are selected for optimal airflow, moisture management, and all-day wearing comfort.

Flexible Midsole Selection: EVA / Phylon / PU / TPR / Memory Foam , each offering different levels of cushioning, rebound, and weight for various end-use scenarios. Shock Absorption Performance: All midsole options are engineered to reduce impact on joints during walking, running, or standing for extended periods. Lightweight Design: Midsole materials are optimized to balance cushioning performance with overall shoe weight.

Customizable Outsole Material: Rubber / TPR / TPU / EVA / PVC outsoles available ,selected based on durability, grip, flexibility, and target terrain requirements. Anti-Slip Traction: All outsole options feature textured or lug patterns designed to provide reliable grip on various surfaces including wet, dry, and uneven ground. Wear-Resistant & Durable: High-abrasion compounds ensure long-lasting outsole performance under daily or heavy-duty use conditions.

Multiple Insole Configurations: Standard foam / Memory foam / Latex / Orthotic arch support / Antibacterial / Removable insoles- tailored to comfort and functional needs. Foot Support & Cushioning: Insoles are designed to evenly distribute pressure across the foot, reducing fatigue during prolonged wear. Hygienic & Replaceable: Removable insole options allow for easy cleaning and replacement, extending the overall lifespan of the footwear.
Full Customization Supported: Logo, colorway, materials, sizing, insole, outsole, and packaging can all be customized to match your brand requirements.

Company Profile
Xiamen Golden Heyman Co., Ltd. is a professional footwear company headquartered in Xiamen, China, dedicated to providing high-quality customized footwear solutions for global buyers.

Core Business
We specialize in OEM & ODM footwear services, covering design, development, and export across a wide range of categories including athletic shoes, casual shoes, outdoor & hiking footwear, fashion shoes, work shoes, children's shoes, and sandals.

Our Advantages
With years of experience in footwear design and international trade, we have built a deep understanding of global market trends and buyer needs. Our in-house design team delivers trend-driven, functional footwear from concept to finished product. We support full customization - including materials, colorways, logo, sole configuration, and packaging -tailored to your brand requirements.

Production Strength
Our manufacturing partners are based in Jinjiang, Fujian -China's renowned "Shoe Capital" - giving us direct access to a world-class supply chain, skilled craftsmen, advanced production equipment, and competitive pricing. This ensures stable capacity and consistent output quality for both small and large-volume orders.

Quality Assurance
We implement a strict multi-stage quality control process covering raw material inspection, in-line production checks, and pre-shipment final inspection. Third-party inspection services (SGS, Bureau Veritas) are available upon request. Our products meet international compliance standards including REACH and RoHS.

We welcome inquiries from brand owners, importers, wholesalers, and retailers worldwide. Your vision, our craftsmanship.
Can you provide custom sample service?

Yes, we fully support custom sample development. You can provide your own design files, reference samples, or simply share your ideas - our design team will develop the sample accordingly. We offer complete OEM & ODM customization including upper materials, colorways, logo, sole, insole, and packaging.
What is the sampling lead time?
The standard sampling lead time is 20 days after design confirmation and sample fee payment. This covers pattern making, material sourcing, and sample construction.
How many colorways can I choose per sample style?
For each sample style, you can select up to 3 colorways per order. This allows you to evaluate multiple color options before confirming your bulk order.
What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)

Our standard MOQ is 1,000 pairs per style. This ensures material procurement at a scale that keeps unit costs competitive. Smaller quantities significantly increase per-unit material and production costs, making it difficult to offer reasonable pricing.
Do you recommend using existing sole molds?

Yes, we strongly recommend choosing from our existing sole and insole mold library whenever possible. Using ready-made molds can greatly reduce development costs and lead time, making it a much more cost-effective option -especially for new customers or smaller brands.
What if I need a brand new outsole mold?

Developing a new outsole mold requires approximately 20 days and a mold opening fee. Please note that each shoe size requires a separate mold, so the total investment depends on the size run needed. We recommend confirming the full size range before initiating new mold development to avoid unnecessary costs.
What is the lead time for bulk production?
After sample confirmation and deposit payment, bulk production lead time is 50-60 days. This includes material preparation, cutting, stitching, assembly, and quality inspection before shipment.
What is the general ordering process?

Our standard process is as follows:Inquiry & Design Confirmation--Sample Development (20 days)-- Sample Approval --Bulk Order Confirmation & Deposit-- Mass Production (50-60 days) --QC Inspection -- Shipment
